item.title: Show HN: Create tweet-style and text-first social posts
item.summary: Hi everyone! I post on a few Facebook pages every day. They all have the same format: a tweet-style post - an image, with a name, a photo, and the body. First time ever, I searched for this template and couldn't find none. Tried Canva, searched for templates, find none either. Then I designed one from scratch on Canva. Now, I want others to never design it again. Simple app. A tweet-style template. You change the photo, name, and add your content, then download the image as JPG to post on Socials. Very simple. No login. No backend. No AI features. 100% free. Built for myself - but might be useful to others. Enjoy! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49181591 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
